name: Python security
covers: Rerail's own Python security rules, from OWASP and the frameworks' security docs, for untrusted input that reaches SQL, shells, URLs, files or deserializers.

rules.title: Don't build SQL from request data
Don't run shell commands or programs built from request data

caught.text:
import subprocess


def ping(host):
    result = subprocess.run(f"ping -c1 {host}", shell=True)
    return result.returncode == 0

passes.text:
import shlex
import subprocess


def ping(host):
    result = subprocess.run(f"ping -c1 {shlex.quote(host)}", shell=True)
    return result.returncode == 0

rules.title: Don't run request data as code: eval, pickle, unsafe YAML or template source
Don't trust a JWT you didn't verify
Don't build file paths from request data
Don't let request data pick where the server sends HTTP requests
Don't let the client choose ORM lookup names
